files.rationale: Both PRs bind the same log-timestamp-format flag to OPENFGA_LOG_TIMESTAMP_FORMAT under different constant names, so I kept a single binding using PR A's logTimestampFormatFlag name, which the merged migrate_test.go refers to.

I kept one set of log flags under PR A's constant names and logger wiring, plus a single gofmt-aligned const block; the defaults come from PR B's config.DefaultConfig() (text/info/Unix, the same values PR A's tests expect) and the help text is PR A's more descriptive version.

The two PRs log the same events in different ways, so I used PR A's cfg.Logger approach throughout: a nil Logger gets a default text logger to stay backward compatible, which drops PR B's redundant noop-logger fallback, its duplicate log variable and its now-unused zap import.
